Victoria.reason: Victoria Line: Severe delays due to an earlier customer incident. Tickets are being accepted on London Buses via any reasonable route.

Waterloo & City.reason: Waterloo and City Line: No service due to strike action. Tube services on other lines will finish early tonight so please complete your journey by 21:00.

Weaver.reason: WEAVER LINE: Monday 23, Tuesday 24, Wednesday 25 and Thursday 26 November, after 2245 each evening, no service between Hackney Downs and Cheshunt / Enfield Town. Use London Underground connections between Central London and Seven Sisters, and for Rectory Road and Stoke Newington, use Clapton station. Last trains operate at 2243 from Liverpool Street to Cheshunt (except on Wednesday when it is at 2213), 2250 from Enfield Town to Liverpool Street, 2258 from Liverpool Street to Enfield Town and 2259 from Cheshunt to Liverpool Street.
